case_name: Forgery of valuable security, will, etc
issues: Forgery of valuable security, will, etc
court_reasoning: Substituted by Act 26 of 1955, section 117 and Schedule, for "transportation for life" (w.e.f. 1-1-1956)
holding: Punished with imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine
